default_hazard.note: Used only when the Bones site hazard step has no values; the dashboard says so. Same fallback as step 4.

concrete.name: Concrete
pros: Good fire and acoustic performance without added protection
cons: One floor pour at a time, with shoring and reshoring below

steel.name: Steel
pros: Long spans and easy future changes
cons: Braced bays limit openings along those lines

mass_timber.name: Mass timber
mass_timber.gravity: CLT floors on a glulam frame
mass_timber.lateral: a concrete core (special reinforced concrete shear walls)
pros: Prefabricated panels and a warm, exposed structure
cons: Acoustic and moisture detailing need early attention
